en.body: In June 2023, Unigestion Private Equity acquired Springer Nature’s mobility education and training business via a carve-out, consolidating the assets into the newly formed TecVia Group — a leading pan-European provider of content and software for driving schools and commercial driver training, headquartered in Munich.
highlights: 100% carve-out of Springer Nature’s mobility education & training unit
Operations across Germany, France, Spain, Austria and Switzerland
Brands include Verlag Heinrich Vogel, Codes Rousseau and Etrasa
Full-stack offering: ERP, teaching software, content and driving simulators

de.body: Im Juni 2023 erwarb Unigestion Private Equity im Rahmen eines Carve-outs das Mobility-Education- und Training-Geschäft von Springer Nature und bündelte die Assets in der neu gegründeten TecVia Group — einem führenden pan-europäischen Anbieter von Content- und Software-Lösungen für Fahrschulen und Nutzfahrzeug-Ausbildung mit Sitz in München.
highlights: 100%-Carve-out der Mobility-Education- & Training-Einheit von Springer Nature
Standorte in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien, Österreich und der Schweiz
Marken u. a. Verlag Heinrich Vogel, Codes Rousseau und Etrasa
Leistungsangebot: ERP, Lehrsoftware, Content und Fahrsimulatoren

it.body: Nel giugno 2023 Unigestion Private Equity ha acquisito, tramite carve-out, il business di formazione e training per la mobilità di Springer Nature, consolidando gli asset nel nuovo gruppo TecVia — fornitore pan-europeo leader di contenuti e software per autoscuole e formazione di conducenti professionali, con sede a Monaco.
highlights: Carve-out al 100% dell’unità mobility education & training di Springer Nature
Presenza in Germania, Francia, Spagna, Austria e Svizzera
Brand tra cui Verlag Heinrich Vogel, Codes Rousseau ed Etrasa
Offerta end-to-end: ERP, software didattico, contenuti e simulatori

en.body: In 2021, Unigestion Private Equity led an investment in Home Instead Holding (today Dovida), a Rheinfelden-based international provider of non-medical home care, alongside founder Paul Fritz and Swiss family office Verium. The platform supports seniors and other clients in living independently at home across Europe and Australasia.
highlights: Founded in Switzerland in 2007 (formerly Home Instead)
Approx. 12,000 caregivers across the network
Presence in Switzerland, Ireland, Australia, the Netherlands and further markets
Services include companion care, home help, overnight and dementia care

de.body: 2021 führte Unigestion Private Equity eine Investition in Home Instead Holding (heute Dovida) an — einen in Rheinfelden ansässigen internationalen Anbieter nicht-medizinischer häuslicher Pflege — gemeinsam mit Gründer Paul Fritz und dem Schweizer Family Office Verium. Die Plattform unterstützt Senioren und weitere Klienten dabei, möglichst lange selbstbestimmt zu Hause zu leben.
highlights: Gegründet 2007 in der Schweiz (ehemals Home Instead)
Rund 12.000 Mitarbeitende im Pflegenetzwerk
Präsenz in der Schweiz, Irland, Australien, den Niederlanden und weiteren Märkten
Leistungen u. a. Begleitung, Haushaltshilfe, Nachtbetreuung und Demenzpflege

it.body: Nel 2021 Unigestion Private Equity ha guidato un investimento in Home Instead Holding (oggi Dovida), provider internazionale di assistenza domiciliare non medica con sede a Rheinfelden, insieme al fondatore Paul Fritz e al family office svizzero Verium. La piattaforma aiuta anziani e altri clienti a vivere a casa in modo indipendente in Europa e Australasia.
highlights: Fondata in Svizzera nel 2007 (ex Home Instead)
Circa 12.000 caregiver nella rete
Presenza in Svizzera, Irlanda, Australia, Paesi Bassi e altri mercati
Servizi tra cui companion care, aiuto domestico, assistenza notturna e demenza

en.body: In December 2021, CMP Capital Management-Partners (via German Opportunity Fund III) acquired 100% of Gustav Wolf GmbH, a Gütersloh-based manufacturer of steel wire ropes for elevators and cranes founded in 1887. The investment supported an operational repositioning and further capital for European market-share growth.
highlights: 100% share acquisition by CMP / GOF III (Dec 2021)
Approx. 500 employees across plants in DE, HU, PL, CN and the US
Annual turnover of more than EUR 80 million at announcement
Ninth investment of CMP’s German Opportunity Fund III

de.body: Im Dezember 2021 übernahm CMP Capital Management-Partners (über den German Opportunity Fund III) 100% der Anteile an der Gustav Wolf GmbH, einem 1887 gegründeten Hersteller von Stahldrahtseilen für Aufzüge und Krane mit Sitz in Gütersloh. Die Investition diente der operativen Neuaufstellung und weiterer Kapitalbereitstellung für Marktanteilsgewinne in Europa.
highlights: 100%-Anteilserwerb durch CMP / GOF III (Dez. 2021)
Rund 500 Mitarbeitende an Standorten in DE, HU, PL, CN und den USA
Jahresumsatz von mehr als 80 Mio. EUR zum Zeitpunkt der Ankündigung
Neunte Investition des German Opportunity Fund III von CMP

it.body: Nel dicembre 2021 CMP Capital Management-Partners (tramite German Opportunity Fund III) ha acquisito il 100% di Gustav Wolf GmbH, produttore di funi di acciaio per ascensori e gru fondato nel 1887 con sede a Gütersloh. L’investimento ha sostenuto il riposizionamento operativo e ulteriore capitale per la crescita della quota di mercato in Europa.
highlights: Acquisizione del 100% da parte di CMP / GOF III (dic. 2021)
Circa 500 dipendenti in impianti in DE, HU, PL, CN e USA
Fatturato annuo superiore a 80 mln di EUR al momento dell’annuncio
Nona investimento del German Opportunity Fund III di CMP

sources.en: Lift-Journal — CMP takes over Gustav Wolf

en.body: In 2025, Unigestion Private Equity joined Apheon as a capital partner in Ortivity, Germany’s leading outpatient orthopaedic care platform. An approximately EUR 200 million capital injection financed continued cluster expansion under a physician-led partnership model, with Apheon remaining lead investor and Unigestion taking a significant minority stake.
highlights: Founded in 2022 by leading physicians together with Apheon
More than 100 medical centres across regional clusters in Germany
Approx. EUR 200m capital injection; Unigestion as significant minority partner
Physician partnership model with roughly half of ownership held by physicians

de.body: 2025 stieg Unigestion Private Equity als Kapitalpartner neben Apheon bei Ortivity ein — Deutschlands führender Plattform für ambulante Orthopädie. Eine Kapitalzufuhr von rund 200 Mio. EUR finanzierte den weiteren Cluster-Ausbau unter einem arztgeführten Partnerschaftsmodell; Apheon bleibt Lead-Investor, Unigestion hält eine signifikante Minderheitsbeteiligung.
highlights: 2022 von führenden Ärzten gemeinsam mit Apheon gegründet
Mehr als 100 medizinische Zentren in regionalen Clustern in Deutschland
Kapitalzufuhr von rund 200 Mio. EUR; Unigestion als signifikanter Minderheitsinvestor
Arztpartnerschaftsmodell mit rund der Hälfte der Anteile in Ärztehand

it.body: Nel 2025 Unigestion Private Equity è entrata come partner di capitale accanto ad Apheon in Ortivity, principale piattaforma tedesca di cura ortopedica ambulatoriale. Un aumento di capitale di circa 200 mln di EUR ha finanziato l’espansione dei cluster con modello di partnership guidato dai medici; Apheon resta lead investor, Unigestion acquisisce una quota di minoranza significativa.
highlights: Fondata nel 2022 da medici di riferimento insieme ad Apheon
Oltre 100 centri medici in cluster regionali in Germania
Aumento di capitale di circa 200 mln di EUR; Unigestion partner di minoranza
Modello di partnership medica con circa metà della proprietà in mano ai medici

en.body: In May 2025, Renaissance Partners and TPG Rise Climate signed a binding agreement to jointly acquire control of SICIT Group S.p.A., a Chiampo (Vicenza)-based global leader in biostimulants produced from leather-industry residues under a circular model. Schroders Capital participated as a major co-investor alongside LGT Capital Partners, with Intesa Holding retaining a minority stake.
highlights: Co-control partnership: Renaissance Partners and TPG Rise Climate
Schroders Capital and LGT Capital Partners as major co-investors
Circular model converting tannery by-products into agri-inputs and related products
Export-led B2B franchise serving agrochemical customers worldwide

de.body: Im Mai 2025 unterzeichneten Renaissance Partners und TPG Rise Climate eine bindende Vereinbarung zum gemeinsamen Erwerb der Kontrolle an der SICIT Group S.p.A., einem in Chiampo (Vicenza) ansässigen globalen Marktführer für Biostimulanzien aus Gerberei-Nebenprodukten in einem zirkulären Modell. Schroders Capital beteiligte sich als wesentlicher Co-Investor neben LGT Capital Partners; Intesa Holding behält eine Minderheitsbeteiligung.
highlights: Co-Control-Partnerschaft: Renaissance Partners und TPG Rise Climate
Schroders Capital und LGT Capital Partners als wesentliche Co-Investoren
Zirkuläres Modell: Gerberei-Nebenprodukte zu Agrar-Inputs und verwandten Produkten
Exportstarkes B2B-Geschäft mit agrochemischen Kunden weltweit

it.body: Nel maggio 2025 Renaissance Partners e TPG Rise Climate hanno firmato un accordo vincolante per acquisire congiuntamente il controllo di SICIT Group S.p.A., leader globale con sede a Chiampo (Vicenza) nella produzione di biostimolanti da residui dell’industria conciaria con modello circolare. Schroders Capital ha partecipato come co-investitore rilevante insieme a LGT Capital Partners; Intesa Holding mantiene una quota di minoranza.
highlights: Partnership di co-controllo: Renaissance Partners e TPG Rise Climate
Schroders Capital e LGT Capital Partners tra i principali co-investitori
Modello circolare: sottoprodotti di conceria in input agricoli e prodotti correlati
Business B2B orientato all’export verso clienti agrochimici globali

en.body: Schroders Capital deepened its minority investment in SABSEG Group alongside majority shareholder Miura Partners as part of a shareholder recapitalisation supporting the platform’s Southern European buy-and-build strategy in specialised insurance brokerage for SMEs and the middle market.
highlights: Specialised insurance brokerage platform across Spain, Portugal and Italy
Network of ~2,000 agents and 60+ offices; ~350,000 clients
More than EUR 800m gross written premiums in 2025
Growth plan targeting EUR 2bn GWP by 2030 with >EUR 350m committed capital

de.body: Schroders Capital verstärkte seine Minderheitsbeteiligung an der SABSEG Group gemeinsam mit Mehrheitsaktionär Miura Partners im Rahmen einer Rekapitalisierung der Aktionärsbasis — zur Unterstützung der Buy-and-Build-Strategie in Südeuropa im spezialisierten Versicherungsbrokerage für KMU und Mid-Market.
highlights: Spezialisierte Versicherungsbroker-Plattform in Spanien, Portugal und Italien
Netzwerk mit rund 2.000 Agenten und über 60 Büros; ca. 350.000 Kunden
Mehr als 800 Mio. EUR Bruttobeiträge (GWP) im Jahr 2025
Wachstumsplan mit Ziel 2 Mrd. EUR GWP bis 2030 und >350 Mio. EUR Kapitalzusage

it.body: Schroders Capital ha rafforzato la propria partecipazione di minoranza in SABSEG Group insieme all’azionista di maggioranza Miura Partners, nel quadro di una ricapitalizzazione della base azionaria a supporto della strategia buy-and-build nell’Europa meridionale nel brokeraggio assicurativo specializzato per PMI e mid-market.
highlights: Piattaforma di brokeraggio assicurativo specializzato in Spagna, Portogallo e Italia
Rete di circa 2.000 agenti e oltre 60 uffici; circa 350.000 clienti
Oltre 800 mln di EUR di premi lordi (GWP) nel 2025
Piano di crescita verso 2 mld di EUR di GWP entro il 2030 con >350 mln di EUR di capitale
